winning_patterns.pattern: Digital micro-actions as a metaphor for self-worth
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'rwOUYo_hayQ' (41 views) and 'AfaLxMy6FMY' (41 views) focused on removing names from status lists or deleting chats.
winning_patterns.action: Continue utilizing micro-digital habits (like clearing app histories, blocking, or changing settings) as hooks for emotional self-respect.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic abstract emotional statements without a physical action hook
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos with vague hooks like '6KVEZc22kS8' (1 view) or 'cuKSS0gHyt0' (0 views) underperformed severely.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract philosophical intros; ground every story in an immediate, tactile digital or physical object.
